description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTwigCallable' implementing 'TwigCallableInterface' within the Twig templating engine. It manages callable objects with options for deprecation, environment, context, and charset needs, including methods for handling arguments, deprecation warnings, and string representation.

classes.name: AbstractTwigCallable
classes.description: An abstract class for creating callable objects in Twig with support for deprecation and environment options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the callable with name, optional callable, and options, handling deprecation info setup.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including class name and callable name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the callable.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns the dynamic name of the callable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable associated with this object.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the node class specified in options.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a clone with specified dynamic arguments and names.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method to set arguments; use withDynamicArguments instead.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable is variadic.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is deprecated.

methods.name: triggerDeprecation
methods.description: Triggers a deprecation warning via deprecation info.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the deprecating package.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the deprecated version.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the alternative suggestion.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates the minimum number of arguments required based on options and arguments.
